422: 	 * 								thumbnail will be sized to fit within the
423: 	 * 								specified dimensions, if the thumbnail is
424: 	 * 								going to exceed those dimensions.
425: 	 * @param useExifOrientation	Whether or not to use the Exif metadata to
426: 	 * 								determine the orientation of the thumbnail.
427: 	 * 								<p>
428: 	 * 								If {@code true} is specified, then the
429: 	 * 								Exif metadata will be used to determine
430: 	 * 								the orientation of the thumbnail.
431: 	 *
432: 	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException 	If size is {@code null} or if the
433: 	 * 										dimensions are negative, or if the
434: 	 * 										{@link Resizer} is null.
435: 	 * @since	0.4.3
436: 	 */
437: 	public ThumbnailParameter(
438: 			Dimension thumbnailSize,
439: 			Region sourceRegion,
440: 			boolean keepAspectRatio,
441: 			String outputFormat,
442: 			String outputFormatType,
443: 			float outputQuality,
444: 			int imageType,
445: 			List<ImageFilter> filters,
446: 			Resizer resizer,
447: 			boolean fitWithinDimensions,
448: 			boolean useExifOrientation
449: 	) {
450: 		this(
451: 				thumbnailSize,
452: 				Double.NaN,
453: 				Double.NaN,
454: 				sourceRegion,
455: 				keepAspectRatio,
456: 				outputFormat,
457: 				outputFormatType,
458: 				outputQuality,
459: 				imageType,
460: 				filters,
461: 				new FixedResizerFactory(resizer),
462: 				fitWithinDimensions,
463: 				useExifOrientation
464: 		);
465: 		
466: 		validateThumbnailSize();
467: 	}
468: 	
469: 	/**
470: 	 * Creates an object holding the parameters needed in order to make a
471: 	 * thumbnail.
472: 	 * 
473: 	 * @param widthScalingFactor	The scaling factor to apply to the width
474: 	 * 								when creating a	thumbnail from the original
475: 	 * 								image.
476: 	 * @param heightScalingFactor	The scaling factor to apply to the height
477: 	 * 								when creating a	thumbnail from the original
478: 	 * 								image.
479: 	 * @param sourceRegion		The region of the source image to use when
480: 	 * 							creating a thumbnail.
481: 	 * 							A value of {@code null} indicates that the
482: 	 * 							entire source image should be used to create
483: 	 * 							the thumbnail.
484: 	 * @param keepAspectRatio	Indicates whether or not the thumbnail should
485: 	 * 							maintain the aspect ratio of the original image.
486: 	 * @param outputFormat		A string indicating the compression format
487: 	 * 							that should be applied on the thumbnail.
488: 	 * 							A value of
489: 	 * 							{@link ThumbnailParameter#ORIGINAL_FORMAT}
490: 	 * 							should be provided if the same image format as
491: 	 * 							the original should	be used for the thumbnail.
492: 	 * 							A value of
493: 	 * 							{@link ThumbnailParameter#DETERMINE_FORMAT}
494: 	 * 							should be provided if the output format of the
495: 	 * 							thumbnail should be the determined from the
496: 	 * 							information available, such as the output file
497: 	 * 							name of the thumbnail.
498: 	 * @param outputFormatType	A string indicating the compression type that
499: 	 * 							should be used when writing the thumbnail.
500: 	 * 							A value of
501: 	 * 							{@link ThumbnailParameter#DEFAULT_FORMAT_TYPE}
502: 	 * 							should be provided if the thumbnail should be
503: 	 * 							written using the default compression type of
504: 	 * 							the codec specified in {@code outputFormat}.
505: 	 * @param outputQuality		A value from {@code 0.0f} to {@code 1.0f} which
506: 	 * 							indicates the quality setting to use for the
507: 	 * 							compression of the thumbnail. {@code 0.0f}
508: 	 * 							indicates the lowest quality, {@code 1.0f}
509: 	 * 							indicates the highest quality setting for the
510: 	 * 							compression.
511: 	 * 							{@link ThumbnailParameter#DEFAULT_QUALITY}
512: 	 * 							should be specified when the codec's default
513: 	 * 							compression quality settings should be used.
514: 	 * @param imageType 		The {@link BufferedImage} image type of the
515: 	 * 							thumbnail.
516: 	 * 							A value of
517: 	 * 							{@link ThumbnailParameter#DEFAULT_IMAGE_TYPE}
518: 	 *							should be specified when the default image
519: 	 *							type should be used when creating the thumbnail.
520: 	 * @param filters			The {@link ImageFilter}s to apply to the
521: 	 * 							thumbnail.
522: 	 * 							A value of {@code null} will be recognized as
523: 	 * 							no filters are to be applied.
524: 	 * 							The filters are applied after the original
525: 	 * 							image has been resized.
526: 	 * @param resizer			The {@link Resizer} to use when performing the
527: 	 * 							resizing operation to create a thumbnail.
528: 	 * @param fitWithinDimensions	Whether or not to fit the thumbnail within
529: 	 * 								the specified dimensions.
530: 	 * 								<p>
531: 	 * 								If {@code true} is specified, then the
532: 	 * 								thumbnail will be sized to fit within the
533: 	 * 								specified dimensions, if the thumbnail is
534: 	 * 								going to exceed those dimensions.
535: 	 * @param useExifOrientation	Whether or not to use the Exif metadata to
536: 	 * 								determine the orientation of the thumbnail.
537: 	 * 								<p>
538: 	 * 								If {@code true} is specified, then the
539: 	 * 								Exif metadata will be used to determine
540: 	 * 								the orientation of the thumbnail.
541: 	 * 
542: 	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException 	If the scaling factor is not a
543: 	 * 										rational number or is less than or
544: 	 * 										equal to 0, or if the
545: 	 * 										{@link Resizer} is null.
546: 	 * @since	0.4.3
547: 	 */
548: 	public ThumbnailParameter(
549: 			double widthScalingFactor,
550: 			double heightScalingFactor,
551: 			Region sourceRegion,
552: 			boolean keepAspectRatio,
553: 			String outputFormat,
554: 			String outputFormatType,
555: 			float outputQuality,
556: 			int imageType,
557: 			List<ImageFilter> filters,
558: 			Resizer resizer,
559: 			boolean fitWithinDimensions,
560: 			boolean useExifOrientation
561: 	) {
562: 		this(
563: 				null,
564: 				widthScalingFactor,
565: 				heightScalingFactor,
566: 				sourceRegion,
567: 				keepAspectRatio,
568: 				outputFormat,
569: 				outputFormatType,
570: 				outputQuality,
571: 				imageType,
572: 				filters,
573: 				new FixedResizerFactory(resizer),
574: 				fitWithinDimensions,
575: 				useExifOrientation
576: 		);
577:
